claims.assertion: Mari said karma can mean cause and effect, but she defined “living in karma” as obeying imposed rules in fear and guilt, surrendering personal judgment.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She defined dharma as living according to one’s authentic self with personal responsibility, saying ethical standards evolve with consciousness and knowledge.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari argued that sustainable service to others requires responsible self-care and reciprocal cooperation, including among like-minded people living far apart.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: Her claim that personal manifestation changes the wider world
